jobs.how: Write AV 363 = 1 to make the unit occupied, and rewrite it after every controller power cycle; it otherwise defaults to NOT USED, leaving the unit unoccupied. It does not time out on lost communication.

points.use: Read occupancy source: 1 local, 2 BMS schedule, 4 override

jobs.how: AV 291 reports the operating mode, from free cooling through heating, dehumidification and smoke modes. AV 290 shows the cooling or heating demand behind it.

points.use: Read mode: 1 free cool, 2 mech cool, 12 vent

jobs.how: The BACnet air source linkage (ASL) points take mode, heat/cool requests, occupancy and optimal start from the BMS. Read AV 628 to see whether linkage is active.
Fan and damper state points share one scale (0 off, 4 running, 7 tripout); the mode points show what each one is controlling to. Read them only; none here are commands.

points.use: Read indoor fan state: 4 = running, 7 = tripout
Read outdoor air damper mode, e.g. 6 = IAQ override

jobs.how: Circuit, compressor and heater states use the same 0-8 scale (4 running, 6 disable, 7 tripout). Circuit B and second compressors exist only on units that have them.

points.use: Read circuit A mode: 0 normal, 1 test, 2 max

jobs.how: Read AV 297 for pre-filter status and the two dirty-filter alarm BVs. The change-source points configure where the filter signals come from.
Every alarm code has its own BV (0 normal, 1 alarm). Poll BV 8094 for any active alarm, then the individual BVs for detail; write BV 1 to reset.

points.use: Read supply air temperature sensor failure
Read outside air temperature thermistor failure

jobs.how: Start counts and run hours are read-only counters kept per component; only components fitted to the unit report.

checklist: Confirm the controller runs software 4.X, since versions before 2.4.0 and earlier SmartVu lists use different instances, so an older point map cannot be reused.
From the SmartVu touchscreen set J7 or J8 to BACnet MS/TP, or set the IP settings for the Ethernet port, remembering only one of CCN or BACnet can run, then reboot.
Discover the device and read AV 291 (MDESTS_OP_STATE), AV 731 (STATES_OCCSRNUM) and AV 727 (STATES_IDFNUM) to check the unit is reporting.
Write AV 363 (GENUNIT_NETOCC) = 1 and check AV 731 to see which occupancy source is in effect.
Set the BMS to rewrite AV 363 after every controller power cycle, because it defaults to NOT USED and leaves the unit unoccupied.
If the BMS sends network sensor values, rewrite them at least every 10 minutes (service configurable) and after a power cycle, or the unit falls back to its local sensor.
Test AV 366 (OCCSBNET) = 1 for occupied standby, then write 0 to return it to normal.
Map BV 8094 (ALARMRST_ALM_ACT) and the individual alarm BVs you need, plus AV 297 (FILTER_STATUS), and use BV 1 (ALARMRST_RST_ALM) for alarm reset.
